blocks.text: Emerald City Leadership Network – Membership Application
Describe your work and why you're interested in joining the network:

General machining, custom fabrication, repair. Lathe, mill, welding. I see things break. I fix them. The network seems like it connects the people who need fixing with the people who can fix it. Efficient.
Please share one or two recent examples of your work that benefited another person, business, or community effort in Oz.

Two last week. First, Gillikin Growers called. Their big cider press had a worn bronze bushing seized up. They had a bin of apples waiting. I turned a new one on the lathe from stock bronze. Took about three hours. They picked it up, press ran fine.

Second was a dairy farm down in Quadling Country. Their main barn door hinge pin sheared off. Big steel rod. Door wouldn't move. They called late, needed it for morning milking. I turned a new pin from a rod of mild steel on the lathe, matched the taper. Drove it over myself. They got the door hung by midnight.
What skills or resources could you offer to other network members?
Metalwork. Machining. Fast turnaround on custom parts. I've got a good stock of common metals – bronze, steel, aluminum. Can sometimes advise on a design if it's going to keep breaking.
What are you hoping to find or learn through the network?
Who else is making things. Who needs things made. Better ways to get materials. Maybe find a source for decent tool steel without going through three brokers.
